title: Easy Chia Seed Summer Fruit Jam
steps: Warm fruit in a small saucepan over low heat until soft.
Add vanilla extract and honey; bring to a simmer; cook gently 3–4 minutes.
Mash the fruit with a potato masher.
Stir in chia seeds; transfer to a 250ml jar. Cool, stir again, store in fridge.
notes: Keeps 1 week in fridge. Sweeter fruits may need less honey. Works with any berries.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
